standard.summary: 有 edit_mask 时用于提高或降低编辑区域 loss
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: With an edit_mask present, raises or lowers the loss in the edit region
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 有 edit_mask 时用于提高或降低编辑区域 loss 权重。1.0 表示不额外改权重。

advanced_en.principle: When an edit_mask is present, raises or lowers the loss weight of the edited region. 1.0 means no extra weighting.
